$comment: Persian generic-copy lists for audit.mjs --slop. Warnings only. Text is normalized before matching (ي→ی, ك→ک, أإ→ا, ؤ→و, diacritics and tatweel removed, ZWNJ = space, digits ۰-۹/٠-٩ = 0-9); write patterns with plain spaces. Skipped: HTML comments, <script>/<style>, attributes, Blade/PHP expressions, and <footer>, <address> and contact blocks. A project can allow phrases or turn rules off in .slop-allow.json.
